cases.title: Explore Health > Execrcise

steps.step: Tap the Health tab in the bottom navigation bar.
steps.expected_result: The Health screen is displayed with exercise-related options visible.

steps.step: Tap on the Exercise card in the Health screen to explore the Exercise section.
steps.expected_result: The Exercise detail screen or expanded view is displayed.

steps.step: Tap on the Exercise section in the Health tab to explore its functionality.
steps.expected_result: The Exercise section opens, showing exercise tracking options or a detail screen for adding/viewing exercise data.

steps.step: Enter 5000 steps in the Steps field and tap Save to log an exercise entry.
steps.expected_result: The exercise entry is saved and the Add Exercise dialog closes or confirms the save.

steps.step: Tap on the Exercise section in the Health tab to explore its functionality.
steps.expected_result: The Exercise section opens, showing exercise tracking options or a detail screen for adding/viewing exercise data.

steps.step: Verify that the Exercise entry is visible on the Health screen after being added.
steps.expected_result: The Exercise card shows '42.5 min' with a timestamp, confirming the entry was saved successfully.

cases.execution_comment: pass: Successfully explored Health > Exercise. An exercise entry of 42.5 min was added and is now visible on the Health screen with the label 'Exercise 42.5 min Target: Not Set 01:21 PM'.
